outcome: Umbilical cord blood concentrations of adrenal glucocorticoids (cortisol, corticosterone)
Fetal adrenal steroid synthesis and clearance pathways
cohort: The study included paired arterial and venous umbilical cord samples from 53 full-term human fetuses (33 male) delivered via scheduled Caesarian section without antecedent labor.
finding: The study confirmed preferential fetal corticosterone synthesis in both sexes, higher umbilical cord concentrations of cortisol in females than males, and found that substrate depletion could account for only 20% of net female cortisol synthesis, in contrast to males where increased fetal synthesis was balanced by equivalent molar depletion of substrate pools.
cross-section timing: At the time of scheduled Caesarian delivery
